field.label: Restrict Outer EAP Methods
field.help: When enabled, only the selected outer EAP methods are permitted for EAP authentication terminated locally. RADIUS proxy behavior is unchanged. When disabled, FreeRADIUS uses its normal EAP configuration. Inner authentication within PEAP or EAP-TTLS is unaffected.

field.label: Allowed Outer EAP Methods
field.help: Select the permitted outer EAP methods. The Default EAP Type must be included. Methods must also satisfy their other configuration requirements, such as enabling EAP-PWD.

field.label: Default EAP Type inside TTLS
field.help: EAP method used inside the EAP-TTLS tunnel, applied only when the client starts an EAP conversation inside the tunnel. Non-EAP inner methods such as PAP or MSCHAPv2 are handled by the inner-tunnel virtual server and are not affected by this setting. Choose GTC for EAP-TTLS-GTC against an LDAP backend. Outer EAP method restrictions do not affect this setting.

field.label: Use own certificates
field.help: This will activate certificate based authentication (EAP-TLS) and validation (EAP-TTLS). Please choose CA and Certificate below and do not forget to roll out certificates to the clients. If you do not enable this, default installation certificate will be used.

field.label: Root Certificate
field.help: Choose the Root CA. This CA will be trusted to issue client certificates for authentication.

field.label: Server Certificate
field.help: Choose the certificate the Radius service should use.

field.label: Enable EAP-PWD
field.help: This enables EAP-PWD authentication. When outer EAP methods are restricted, also select EAP-PWD under Allowed Outer EAP Methods to allow clients to use it outside a tunnel.

field.label: CRL
field.help: This enables CRL checking, please restart this service with every change to the CRL.

field.label: Check TLS Common-Name
field.help: Checks that the username given by the user matches the Common-Name of the certificate.

field.label: TLS Minimum Version
field.help: Set minimum TLS version. Please be aware that every version below 1.2 is considered as insecure.

field.label: TLS Maximum Version
field.help: Set maximum TLS version. Use 1.2 to avoid TLS 1.3 for legacy clients.
